title: Software Engineer
text: Software Engineer: Build and maintain production software. Required skills include Python, Java, Git, REST APIs, Data Structures and Algorithms, SQL, testing, Docker, and communication. Preferred: Kubernetes and AWS.

title: Frontend Engineer
text: Frontend Engineer: Build accessible web interfaces. Required skills include JavaScript, TypeScript, React, HTML, CSS, Web Accessibility, Git, and software testing. Preferred: Next.js and Playwright.

title: Data Analyst
text: Data Analyst: Analyze business data and communicate findings. Required skills include SQL, Python, Excel, Data Analysis, Data Visualization, Probability and Statistics, and Tableau. Preferred: A/B Testing and dbt.

title: Data Engineer
text: Data Engineer: Design reliable data pipelines. Required skills include Python, SQL, Data Engineering, ETL, Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, Docker, and PostgreSQL. Preferred: Apache Kafka and Snowflake.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
text: Machine Learning Engineer: Develop and deploy machine learning systems. Required skills include Python, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, PyTorch, Model Evaluation, Feature Engineering, MLOps, and Data Engineering. Preferred: Transformers and LLM Applications.

title: Backend Engineer
text: Backend Engineer: Design robust services and APIs. Required skills include Python, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Docker, Git, Distributed Systems, Database Systems, Software Testing, and Linux. Preferred: Kubernetes and Terraform.

title: Full-Stack Developer
text: Build features across the application stack. Required skills include JavaScript, TypeScript, React, REST APIs, SQL, Git, and Software Testing. Preferred: Docker and AWS.

title: Data Scientist
text: Use data and statistical methods to solve business problems. Required skills include Python, SQL, Data Analysis, Probability and Statistics, Machine Learning, Data Visualization, and Model Evaluation. Preferred: PyTorch and A/B Testing.

title: DevOps Engineer
text: Automate software delivery and operate reliable infrastructure. Required skills include Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Terraform, AWS, Git, and Python. Preferred: Cloud Security and Apache Kafka.

title: Cloud Engineer
text: Build and maintain secure cloud infrastructure. Required skills include Cloud Computing, AWS, Azure, Linux, Computer Networks, Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform. Preferred: CloudFormation and VPC Networking.

title: QA Engineer
text: Improve product quality through test design and automation. Required skills include Software Testing, Unit Testing, Integration Testing, Functional Testing, Python, Git, and REST API Testing. Preferred: Playwright and CI/CD.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
text: Monitor systems and investigate security risks. Required skills include Information Security, Network Security, Linux, Computer Networks, Security Operations, Security Auditing, and Python. Preferred: Penetration Testing and Cloud Security.

title: Business Analyst
text: Translate business needs into measurable requirements and reporting. Required skills include Requirements Analysis, SQL, Excel, Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, Data Visualization, Communication, and Project Management. Preferred: Product Analytics and A/B Testing.

title: Product Manager
text: Guide product discovery and delivery across engineering and business teams. Required skills include Product Thinking, Product Strategy, Requirements Analysis, Project Management, Data Analysis, Communication, and Agile. Preferred: Product Analytics and A/B Testing.

title: UI/UX Designer
text: Design usable digital experiences and validate them with users. Required skills include Figma, Usability Testing, Design Systems, Accessibility, Responsive Design, Design Thinking, and Communication. Preferred: Product Thinking and Prototyping.

title: Mobile App Developer
text: Build and maintain mobile applications for Android and iOS. Required skills include Kotlin, Swift, Java, REST APIs, Git, Software Testing, and Database Systems. Preferred: React Native and CI/CD.

title: Database Administrator
text: Maintain performant, available, and secure database systems. Required skills include SQL, Database Systems, PostgreSQL, Relational Databases, Linux Administration, Database Migrations, and Data Quality. Preferred: NoSQL Databases and Cloud Computing.

title: Technical Support Engineer
text: Help customers diagnose and resolve technical issues. Required skills include Linux, Computer Networks, Networking Fundamentals, SQL, REST APIs, Incident Management, Communication, and Troubleshooting. Preferred: Python and Cloud Computing.
